headline: Knee-high leftovers today, but Wednesday is the one to circle.
today: Small SE windswell in the 1ft range at short period, and the wind goes onshore by mid-morning and stays that way. The dawn SW is light enough for a passable glass window but there's just not much to work with. Longboard at first light around the incoming tide or save your energy for tomorrow.

daysToWatch.note: The day. ESE fills in prime-angle to near 4ft at 8s-plus with dawn NE cross-off going ENE cross. Dawn to mid-morning is your window before the E wind builds. Shortboard or groveler.
Still 2-3ft on a prime angle but the period drops to windswell and the dawn wind is onshore. Morning SW cross-on cleans it up some — worth a look if you missed Wednesday.
